name: Scientific Research and Experimental Development (SR&ED) investment tax credit

summary.quote: Use your ITC to reduce income tax payable or get a refund

funding_types.quote: The basic ITC rate is 15% on qualified SR&ED expenditures for corporations, individuals, trusts, and partners in a partnership.

cost_share.text: 15% of qualified SR&ED spending (35% for most Canadian-controlled private corporations, up to the expenditure limit)
cost_share.quote: The basic ITC rate is 15% on qualified SR&ED expenditures for corporations, individuals, trusts, and partners in a partnership.

criteria.text: The money is for scientific research and experimental development
criteria.quote: The basic ITC rate is 15% on qualified SR&ED expenditures for corporations, individuals, trusts, and partners in a partnership.

criteria.text: For the 35% refundable rate: a Canadian-controlled private corporation (CCPC)
criteria.quote: Most Canadian-controlled private corporations (CCPCs), whether stand-alone or associated, may earn a refundable ITC at the enhanced rate of 35% on qualified SR&ED expenditures, up to the expenditure limit.

criteria.text: The spending is qualified SR&ED expenditure

research.notes: Type tax_credit and purpose research are on the page. Rate: cost_share uses the basic 15% everyone gets; the 35% enhanced refundable rate needs a CCPC (or, for tax years after December 15, 2024, an eligible Canadian public corporation), which a profile cannot tell, so it is a check-yourself item and in the text. Structure: the basic rate covers "corporations, individuals, trusts, and partners in a partnership", so no structure answer is ruled out. Intake: a claim goes with a tax return; this page gives no application window, so unknown. What work qualifies is on a separate CRA page (sred-eligibility) not saved here; it stays a check-yourself item. No phone on this page (the contact page was not saved).
